Do you want to make a real impact by driving DevOps transformation in a fast-growing software company?

**Your new role

**As a DevOps Specialist in the Developer Enablement team at Dalux, you will play a key role in improving the developer experience and increasing productivity as we continue to scale. Your focus will be on building, evolving, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure, while promoting DevOps best practices and strong software engineering principles across the organization.

You will work closely with development teams to ensure that our platforms and tooling effectively support a wide range of technologies and product areas.

**Your Responsibilities

**In this role, you will:

• Continuously improve development at Dalux by proposing and implementing new ideas and evolving our systems to better support developers

• Clarify requirements and define technical and architectural solutions in collaboration with team members

• Coach and train internal users (our developers) in using the platforms and tools we provide

• Release, operate, and maintain internal components and products

• Explore, experiment, and research new technologies to identify opportunities for technical improvement

**Our DevOps platform and tech stack

**We aim to build reliable, repeatable, and highly automated pipelines, configured and maintained as code. Our shared and customizable build systems support a broad range of teams — from mobile and web applications to image processing and backend services.

Our primary technologies include:

• Jenkins (Jenkins Pipelines, JCasC)

• GitLab and Nexus (self-hosted)

• Docker

• Hyper-V

• Prometheus, Thanos and Grafana

• MSBuild

• NPM (pnpm and Vite)

• AWS (EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, CloudFormation, S3 etc.)

Builds and tests are orchestrated using Jenkins, with code hosted in GitLab. Our platforms run on both Linux and Windows.

Dalux’ continuous growth makes the environment exciting and ever changing, but is also one of the reasons why our DevOps discipline is behind where we would like it to be.

Alongside the Developer Enablement team, we have a large DevOps Guild that supports the rollout of best practices and knowledge sharing across Dalux. Our development culture is pragmatic and agile, with frequent releases. We apply the same pragmatism to DevOps — once value is demonstrated, we move quickly to implement changes.

**Your background

**We expect that you have an educational background in Software Engineering. In addition, you have either been part of driving DevOps transformations previously and see DevOps as your strongest asset. We have open positions for both experienced DevOps profiles and developers who want to specialize further in DevOps.

**Ready for the next step?

**If Dalux sounds like a place where you could make an impact while continuing to grow as a developer, we would be happy to receive your application. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact **IT Talent Acquisition Specialist, Katrin Nedergaard +45 92909184

**This position is open on an ongoing basis due to our continuous growth. We hire multiple candidates throughout the year and keep the position open to ensure we attract the right talent as we expand.

**About Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Ph.D. Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard. Our products are designed to make the construction industry smarter and more efficient.

Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly digital tools that are used in more than 140 countries worldwide. We are passionate about modern technology and proud to be first movers in applying new technologies - all developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

**Join our Pizza & Beer event

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

**Application deadline:

**Ongoing

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

• Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

• IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

• CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

• Observability: DataDog

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

**Overview:

**Are you a web-savvy, search expert with a talent for finding things online by using just a few words? Do you want to influence the future of global AI search? If so, we want you on board!

Working on behalf of RWS, you will test and evaluate how our clients’ search engine responds to everyday searches from everyday people.

Using your search expertise, you will work through a variety of assignments playing a crucial part in enhancing AI data which will be used to improve the online search engine experience of our clients’ users.

**You:

**

• Inquisitive by nature with a real interest in AI

• Have excellent skills in online research

• Enjoy working in a fast-paced environment

• Continually maintain quality and accuracy SLAs

• Have the self-discipline to stick to a schedule and get the work done despite the potential distractions of a home office

• Be a critical thinker with ability to analyze information and assess its relevance or significance

**Quick overview of the flexible, part-time job:

**Language: English and Danish proficiency.

Location: Denmark (Work from Home).

Schedule: E.g. 8-20 h/week. Avg. 15 h/weekly.

Pay: Up to 22 USD/hour.

Who Should Apply: Ideal for freelancers, students, stay-at-home parents, or anyone seeking flexible remote work to improve AI models. No previous experience is required.

Role Description: Join RWS Group as an evaluator to enhance search engine results. Provide feedback on text, audio, images, and videos to refine AI data used by major search engines, social media sites, streaming platforms and more.

**Requirements

**

• Currently reside in Denmark

• Strong understanding of popular culture in your locale (Denmark)

• Commit to a minimum of 5 hours per week, maximum of 20 hours per week

• Must sign and adhere to project NDA

• Have a smartphone and personal computer with reliable internet connection

• Reliable antivirus software to protect your computer as you surf the web

• Must pass training modules and a required test created by our client before commencing work

• Only one Search Quality Rater per household.

• Must be 18+ years old

**Work Benefits

**

• Flexible home-based work

• Work-life balance

• Potential side-hustle

• Payments via PayPal/Bank Account

• Access to more opportunities through our TrainAI Community

**Vendor Type

****When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

****Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

**A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

Renewable Energy Solution Engineer – Customer & Sales Focus

( PV, BESS, Data Centers, EV, Network)

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark ( DANISH SPEAKING )

Employment: Permanent

Start: ASAP

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Solution Engineer to support technical projects within Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Data Centers, EV Charging Networks and Power Distribution Networks across the Nordic region.

The role combines technical solution implementation, system integration, testing, verification and project delivery with customer engagement, partner collaboration and commercial sales support.

Responsibilities

• Take responsibility for system integration, implementation, testing, verification and project acceptance

• Support technical solution design, including platform deployment and integration verification

• Support business and system surveys for industry solution projects

• Coordinate solution implementation with customers, partners and technical teams

• Support project bidding, service solutions and sales activities across the Nordic region

• Collaborate with headquarters and Nordic teams on service solutions and sales strategies

• Support service operations, customer experience and training of service partners

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in engineering or technology

• More than 3 years of experience in the renewable energy or data center industry

• Experience in solution design, service architecture design, delivery implementation or service integration

• Experience in project support and management

• Basic service or operational experience

• Strong customer relationship skills, commercial awareness and sales awareness

• Good communication and presentation skills

• Fluent Danish and English

• Partner relationship experience and a project management background are preferred

Technical knowledge

General renewable energy industry knowledge and basic product knowledge in at least one of the following areas:

• Solar PV

• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

• Data Centers

• EV Charging Networks

• Power Distribution Networks

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Senior Consultant, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We are looking for highly motivated and ambitious Senior Consultant who can contribute across a broad spectrum of projects — including implementation, optimization, and ongoing consulting for the commercial area (SFE,CRM). The role is open to candidates with either a technical background or a business consulting mindset, as long as you bring curiosity, structure, and a collaborative spirit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, helping clients translate business goals into scalable, system-supported solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• Lead workstreams or small teams on client projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment.

• Conduct process assessments and define future-state operating models across commercial functions.

• Translate business needs into system requirements and support end-to-end implementation of platforms.

• Facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and manage documentation (e.g., project plans, RAID logs).

• Support IT and commercial strategy definition, including CRM optimization and system integration.

• Drive change management activities, including training design, stakeholder engagement, and adoption planning.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, bringing structure, insight, and industry best practices.

• Engage in Sales processes by taking part in RfP responses and delivering presentations.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience ideally in project-based roles within consulting or the life sciences sector implementing solutions for the commercial area.

• Required consulting and hands-on experience in Salesforce, Veeva, and other CRM systems (certifications in Salesforce and Veeva will be a plus). Technical understanding is a plus, especially for projects involving IT collaboration.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written in English.

• Ability to create compelling presentations and confidently present to diverse audiences.

• Proactive mindset with a “can-do” attitude and eagerness to learn.

• Comfortable working in agile teams and remote environments.

• Project Management and Agile methodologies experience (certifications on Agile, PMP... will be a plus).

• Experience facilitating workshops and driving client expectations into sustainable solutions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage change at scale.

• It will be a plus if you have these additional capabilities:

• Experience working in global or regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance).

• Prior consulting experience — especially in top-tier consulting firms — is valued but not required.

• Exposure to enterprise platform rollouts or system integration projects.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Experience contributing to Salesforce Effectiveness initiatives, including CRM usage optimization, sales process alignment, and support for user adoption strategies.

• Interest in emerging technologies and AI.

This position is offered in Denmark.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_**Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

**Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

**As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

**You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

**We value your passion 🔥

**At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

**What We Can Offer You 🌱

**

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

**Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• Has built sales in a B2B SaaS company as one of the first salespeople, with own meetings and own closes

• Has built lead generation from scratch, through outbound, partners or marketing, and knows what pipeline costs to acquire

• Has had a budget and hit it, and can explain in detail how

• Sells personally and teaches others to do it at the same time

• Experience selling outside Denmark, and a feel for what changes when you do

• Strong product and technology understanding, and uses AI every day in their own work

• Danish at native level, confident on calls, in meetings and in demos

• Fluent English is mandatory. English is the office language at Userlink

The person

• Dreams of owning and building a company

• Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• Competitive salary plus uncapped commission

• Equity

• Short decision paths and close collaboration with product and engineering

• Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense, where we are every day

Application process

We take the time it takes to find the right match.

• Introductory conversation

• Conversation about expectations and terms

Write to jobs@userlink.ai about a SaaS product you helped scale, where the meetings came from, and what you personally did to make it happen.

Senior Enterprise Account ExecutiveEnterprise Account Executive.

Copenhagen, on site.

Own the deal from first meeting to signature.

Focalx builds artificial intelligence that finds damage on vehicles in finished vehicle logistics, car rental and other use cases. Finished vehicle logistics is one of the largest supply chains in the world, and one of the least digitized. Most of it still runs on paper and manual damage checks.

Our customers are car makers, logistics providers, ports, rail operators and car rental fleets etc.

You build the pipeline and close it

This is not a role where a sales development team hands you leads and a script. You find the accounts, run the cycle and sign the contract.

You own enterprise deals from first outreach to signature. They are typically worth USD 100,000-500,000 in annual recurring revenue, and most start with a paid pilot that converts into a 6- or 7 digit USD deal.

You will work closely with our CEO, Morten Brøgger, and a technical pre-sales colleague, and you will on occasion travel to customers internationally. You own the budget, you close deals with everyone at Focalx contributing.

What you'll own:

Build your own pipeline

You contribute actively with insights and research defining our demand generation. We use all channels including outreach by all of us.

Run the full cycle

Discovery, business case, pilot, procurement, negotiation, signature. Before a pilot starts, you agree with the customer and our Customer Success what it has to prove. When the pilot ends, you use the positive ROI business case we build for the customer to close the contract.

Hold the buying committee

Our deals involve operations, finance, technology and procurement teams, often in several countries. You find the person who signs, know who can block the deal, and keep it moving when it stalls.

Bring the field back to us

What you hear from buyers shapes how we price, package and sell. You tell us early, with a proposal attached. You contribute to the product and our go to market strategies in every aspect.

Sell with the agents

Parts of our sales work already run on agents that research prospects, keep HubSpot clean and draft follow-ups. You use them every day and push them further. We are running a very efficient new school startup.

Your traits:

Enterprise closer. You have personally carried large, complex deals to signature and owned the outcome. Long cycles and slow procurement don't put you off.

Buying committee control. You reach the person who signs, keep a committee moving in one direction, and revive deals others had written off.

Credibility in the room. People who have spent 30 years in logistics, Rental or other vehicle verticals take you seriously. You are calm, factual, direct and hard to rattle in a negotiation.

This might come from enterprise software, industrial sales or logistics technology. You don't need automotive experience. You do need to have closed large enterprise deals yourself.

This probably isn't for you if you want a territory, a script and a steady flow of inbound leads. Or if you would rather manage sellers from behind a desk, than sell. Or if you think artificial intelligence in sales is overhyped, or you want to work remotely.

You might be someone who

• Was the person your company sent in when a deal mattered most.

• Got tired of being one account executive of forty, with a territory and a script.

• Closed a deal everyone else had given up on.

• Closed a game changing deal for your company

• Has wondered whether you could do what founders do, and wants to find out.

• Automates your own research and follow-up so you can spend the time with customers.

What good looks like in 12 months

• One or Two strategic deals closed.

• The pilots you sell convert, because what they had to prove was agreed before they started.

• Your pipeline is one you built, and your forecast is one we can plan cash on.

• Complex deals reach signature instead of stalling in procurement.

• Buyers treat Focalx as a serious partner from the first meeting.

Why join:

Own deals from day one • Negotiate at founder level • Enterprise customers, small team • Work directly with the founders • Shape how Focalx sells

How to apply:

Write directly to Morten Brøgger, our CEO, at morten@focalx.ai. Send your CV and a short note on:

• A complex deal you closed that others thought was dead.

• The toughest negotiation you've held your own in.

• Why Focalx, and why now.

SENIOR BACKEND DEVELOPER

🚀 We're looking for an ambitious, self-driven Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team. You'll work primarily with TypeScript and AWS serverless technologies, with occasional work in our React/Next.js frontend. A growing part of our platform is integrating with enterprise customers and external systems, so you'll design and own APIs and integrations that need to hold up under real-world use.

This is a high-impact role with end-to-end ownership, from requirements to a production-ready solution, and a chance to contribute meaningfully to the green transition.

🛠️ What You'll Be Doing

• Taking features from design through implementation and into production

• Building and operating event-driven, distributed systems — async processing, retries, failure handling, idempotency

• Designing APIs and integrations for enterprise and external systems — stable contracts, versioning, auth, error handling, backwards compatibility

• Working in and improving our existing codebase — refactoring, automated testing, managing technical debt

• Occasional frontend work in React/TypeScript

🧠 Your Experience

• 3 to 5+ years of professional software development, with substantial recent experience in TypeScript/Node.js and AWS serverless or event-driven architectures

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services - Lambda, DynamoDB, queues, event buses, API services, infrastructure as code

• Experience with NoSQL data modelling and production data systems

• Good understanding of authentication, authorization and application security

• Experience operating production systems - debugging, monitoring, safely deploying changes

• Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD

• Some React/TypeScript experience, and willingness to make occasional frontend changes

✅ What We Expect at Senior Level

You can independently take a feature or technical problem from requirements to a production-ready solution. You're comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, understanding the blast radius of a change, and making pragmatic calls between delivery speed, reliability and maintainability.

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

🌟 Nice to Have

• Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs

• AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling

• DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling

• IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing

• Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management

• Data platforms, analytics or data lakes

• ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience

• Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

🌆 What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

• Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday

• You're covered with pension contributions

• Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious

• We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level

• Opportunities for individual development

🤝 Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further

• Time with the team - a conversation with Artur, our Head of Engineering, and Robert, our CTO

• A technical stage - one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you. Find a link to apply here 👉 https://thehub.io/jobs/6ab5030dfd5518f38b6960b2?utm_source=client&utm_medium=dashboard&utm_campaign=startupshared

📍 Location & Practical Details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen.

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role

• We do not offer relocation services

🔐 Data Privacy (GDPR)

• Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarize interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process. PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at sam.weller@hay.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Project Scheduler at atNorth

**Are you a master of project controls who thrives on turning complex infrastructure dependencies into highly predictable, synchronized execution plans? As a Project Scheduler at atNorth, you will ensure accurate planning, coordination, and tracking of all activities across the entire data center construction lifecycle. You will act as the critical link connecting our engineering, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring that every milestone from initial design to final commissioning stays firmly on track.

This is a high-impact position within our PMO structure where your analytical insights, critical path analyses, and proactive risk-mapping will directly drive predictable, on-time project delivery across our rapidly expanding Nordic footprint.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Develop, baseline, and maintain fully integrated master schedules for our data center projects, meticulously covering design, permitting, civil works, MEP installation, commissioning, and final handover.

• Ensure procurement timelines for long-lead items (LLI) and owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment are seamlessly integrated into the active construction schedules.

• Monitor schedule performance using Earned Value Management (EVM) and progress metrics. Identify deviations, track float, and proactively flag critical path risks and delay mitigation opportunities to Project Managers and senior stakeholders.

• Rigorously review and challenge external contractor schedules for logic, realism, and contractual compliance, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies before they impact the site.

• Support weekly and monthly programme reviews by preparing updated schedules, dashboards, look-aheads, and scenario/what-if analyses. Partner with Cost Management to align schedule tracking with cash flow forecasting.

• Refine planning standards, templates, and scheduling methodologies in coordination with the PMO to increase delivery efficiency portfolio-wide.

**Your profile:

**

• A technical degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• 5+ years of dedicated project controls, scheduling, or planning experience, with a distinct preference for professionals coming out of the data center sector or complex, mission-critical infrastructure environments.

• Advanced, hands-on proficiency in industry-standard planning tools, specifically Primavera P6 and MS Project.

• Deep understanding of data center design and construction workflows, scheduling logic, interdependencies, and Earned Value Management methodology.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge external contractors and translate complex timeline risks into clear, actionable advice for internal project teams.

• Holding a PMP or Prince2 certification is considered a strong advantage.

• Fluency in written and spoken English is required; proficiency in any local Nordic language is a plus.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Shape the Future of Privacy

**Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

**Requirements

**

**Experience

**> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

**Technical Skills

**> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

**Operating Skills

**> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

**Benefits

**

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we're happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

jobs.description:
Turn technical solutions into customer value

Do you enjoy combining technical expertise with project coordination and finding the right solutions for customer needs?

As Borncut’s new Sales Project Engineer, you will play a central role in supporting our international sales team, turning customer requirements into tailored cutting solutions for food processors worldwide.

Based at our R&D and sales facilities in Hadsten, Denmark, you will work across sales, engineering, procurement and production to develop technical layouts, coordinate sales projects and help bring complex solutions from initial concept to commercial proposal.

Your key responsibilities

You will connect customer needs with technical possibilities, ensuring that each solution is well-designed, commercially sound and feasible to deliver. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Project Management & Layouts: Lead technical sales projects and design detailed production layouts using AutoCAD & Solidworks (2D/3D). Specify system configurations tailored to specific customer processing requirements.

• 
Technical Sales Support: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the global sales team, distributors, and customers. Translate customer needs into precise engineering specifications.

• 
Quotation & Estimation: Collaborate with procurement and production teams to perform technical assessments, cost estimations, and deliver accurate commercial project proposals.

• 
Product Coordination: Align closely with the internal product development and manufacturing engineering departments to ensure feasibility, product scalability, and timely delivery of engineered solutions.

Your qualifications

You are structured, analytical and technically minded, with an eye for detail and an ability to turn complex requirements into workable solutions. We imagine you bring:

• Technical background: A degree in mechanical engineering, production engineering, industrial design or a related technical field, combined with relevant professional experience.

• CAD skills: Hands-on experience with AutoCAD and SolidWorks or similar 2D/3D design tools, including the development of system configurations and production layouts.

• Relevant industry experience: Experience with industrial food processing equipment, automation or heavy machinery is an advantage.

• Commercial understanding: Strong analytical skills and an understanding of technical sales, cost estimation and project planning.

• Communication skills: Fluent written and spoken English, as you will work closely with colleagues, distributors and customers around the world. Danish is an advantage.

What you can look forward to

As our new Sales Project Engineer, you will become an important link between our technical expertise and international sales activities. You can look forward to:

• A key role: Making a direct contribution to customer solutions and Borncut’s continued international growth.

• Technical development: Building in-depth knowledge of our advanced cutting systems and expanding your engineering expertise.

• International collaboration: Working with sales colleagues, distributors and customers across markets.

• A close-knit working environment: Joining an agile team with short lines of communication, a hands-on approach and a shared focus on finding the right solutions.

About Borncut A/S

Borncut A/S was founded by the pioneers behind the modern portion cutter. Based on the Danish island of Bornholm, with R&D and sales facilities in Jutland, we combine decades of specialized industry knowledge with advanced technology to set new standards in intelligent portioning.

Our high-tech solutions help food processors worldwide maximize yield, minimize giveaway and make better use of every cut across poultry, fish and meat processing.

**

Interested?**

If you’re ready to grow an international aftermarket business, strengthen our strategic sourcing and build more efficient operations, we’d love to hear from you as soon as possible.

Deadline: 5th of November

jobs.description:
Lead our global spare parts and purchasing operations

Do you enjoy building business, developing supplier partnerships and turning operational complexity into commercial results?

As Borncut’s new Head of Global Spare Parts and Strategic Purchasing, you will take the lead in growing our global aftermarket business while ensuring the strategic sourcing and availability of components for both our machines and spare parts operations.

Based at our R&D and sales facilities in Hadsten, Denmark, you are going to work closely with colleagues across our sites, leading operations with responsibility for commercial performance, purchasing strategy and operational excellence.

Your key responsibilities

You will bring together business development, strategic sourcing and operational management to build a profitable, responsive and scalable operation. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Revenue Growth & Business Development: Take ownership of the global spare parts business and its P&L, identifying opportunities to grow aftermarket sales, improve margins and increase profitability.

• 
Strategic Sourcing & Purchasing: Lead sourcing and supplier management for critical mechanical and electronic components. Negotiate competitive pricing and reliable lead times while building strong, long-term supplier relationships.

• 
Fast & Transparent Order Fulfilment: Improve order turnaround times by streamlining and automating processes from order entry to dispatch. Remove manual bottlenecks and increase delivery visibility and tracking transparency for customers.

• 
Multi-Site Operations: Provide unified leadership across our operations, working closely with warehousing, engineering and other colleagues in Hadsten, Rønne and Urk to align priorities.

• 
Customer Satisfaction & Service Performance: Establish ways to measure and track customer satisfaction with spare parts availability, delivery and fulfilment. Use performance data and customer feedback to identify and strengthen service levels.

• 
ERP & Inventory Optimization: Drive effective use of Uniconta to improve inventory accuracy, automate replenishment planning and strengthen purchasing, stock control and financial reporting.

• 
Financial Planning & Performance Management: Work closely with the CFO on budgeting, forecasting, lifecycle cost management and operational KPIs, using data to guide decisions and deliver measurable improvements.

Your qualifications

You are a commercially minded and structured leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to improving operations. You understand how purchasing, inventory, supplier performance and customer service work together to drive business results. We imagine you bring:

• Leadership Experience: A strong track record in senior management within spare parts, aftermarket, strategic purchasing or supply chain operations.

• Strategic Purchasing Expertise: Proven experience in sourcing technical components, negotiating supplier agreements and managing supplier relationships in an industrial environment.

• Digital & Analytical Skills: Experience with ERP systems and process automation, along with the ability to use data and KPIs to improve performance. Knowledge of Uniconta is an advantage.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: The ability to bring together purchasing, engineering, warehousing, finance and commercial teams around shared goals.

• Education & Communication: A relevant degree in Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, Business Administration, Engineering or a related field. Fluent English is essential; Danish, Dutch or other European languages are an advantage.

What you can look forward to

As our new Head of Global Spare Parts and Strategic Purchasing, you will have the opportunity to shape a business area with a direct impact on Borncut’s commercial performance, customer relationships and international growth. You can look forward to:

• High-impact leadership: Taking ownership of the development and profitability of our global spare parts business while shaping our purchasing strategy.

• International collaboration: Working with teams and leaders across European locations and collaborating closely with the leadership of Borncut.

• An Innovation-Driven Culture: Joining an international, supportive environment built on continuous innovation, integrity, unity and extreme customer focus.

• Growth Opportunities: Competitive salary, attractive employee benefits, and comprehensive professional development within a globally expanding group.

Borncut A/S was founded by the pioneers behind the modern portion cutter. Based on the Danish island of Bornholm, with R&D and sales facilities in Jutland, we combine decades of specialized industry knowledge with advanced technology to set new standards in intelligent portioning.

Our high-tech solutions help food processors worldwide maximize yield, minimize giveaway and make better use of every cut across poultry, fish and meat processing.
